login2fa.title: Two-step verification
login2fa.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login2fa.error: That code is wrong or expired. Try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Set up an account to start using Devon.

error.conflict: That login is already taken. Choose another.
error.generic: Could not register. Check your details and try again.

sessions.title: Devices and sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every device currently signed in to your account.
sessions.revokeAllConfirm: You'll be signed out on every device, including this one. Continue?

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.subtitle: Add an authenticator app as a second layer of protection.

enroll.step1: Step 1: scan the QR or enter the key
enroll.error: That code is wrong. Check your device's clock.
enroll.recoveryBody: These are shown once. Use one to sign in if you lose access to your phone.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.warning: Your account will be permanently deleted and your personal data anonymised after 30 days. You can cancel any time before then.
delete.confirmDialog: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
delete.scheduled: Your account will be deleted on {date}.

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.confirm: Create a temporary password for this user and end all of their sessions?

settings.title: Account settings
settings.subtitle: Profile, sessions, two-factor authentication and password all live here.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.subtitle: Shown next to your name across Devon.
photo.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. The photo is checked for malware and resized before it is shown.
photo.registerFailedToast: Your account was created, but the photo could not be uploaded. You can add it in Account settings.

error.type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
error.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
error.invalidImage: This file is not a valid image.
error.infected: This file failed the malware check and was not saved.
error.unavailable: Photo upload is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
error.generic: Could not upload the photo. Try again.
